title.en: An Act Reappropriating Certain Sums Appropriated in Republic Act Numbered Sixteen Hundred Thirteen
title.orig: An Act Reappropriating Certain Sums Appropriated in Republic Act Numbered Sixteen Hundred Thirteen

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3292_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
The sums appropriated in Republic Act Numbered Sixteen hundred thirteen under:
1.Item (b), group IV, page 79, subparagraph (28) for the City of Manila, paragraph "f", Section two, for Social Welfare Administration Building, Central Street, Pandacan—Aid for construction ₱10,000.00
2. Item (p), group IV, page 80, subparagraph (28) for the City of Manila, paragraph "f", Section two, for Dart Extension— Asphalt paving from Oregon to Sison Street 7,000.00
3. Item 18, for the City of Manila, page 202 paragraph "g", Section two, for— Public Improvements, 4th District 5,000.00
4. Item 23 for the City of Manila, page 203, paragraph "g", Section two, for— Asphalting of Enriquez Street from Singalong Street to Dart Street, Malate ₱11,000.00
5. Item 29, for the City of Manila, page 203, paragraph "g", Section two, for— Asphalting of A. Flores Street from A.Mabini Street to Nebraska Street, Ermita 4,000.00
6. Project No. B-004.13 for the City of Manila, page 850-A, Title B-High-ways (Feeder and Secondary Roads), Appendix A, for— Estero de Sta. Clara, D el Pan Street: |GR|20.00|10.00|10.00|..|..|..|..|..|..|..|10.00| 3]....
7. Project No. B-004.41, for the City of Manila, page 854-A, Title B-High-ways (Feeder and Secondary Roads), Appendix A,for— Dart Street: From Oregon to Looban ...|GR|15.00|8.00|8.00|....|....|....|....|....|7.00|,...|....|Improvement totalling fifty-five thousand pesos, are hereby reappropriated, for the following1 purposes:
1. Intramuros Health Center, Sta. Potenciana, corner General Luna Street— Construction ₱20,000.00
2. All streets in Fabie Estate, Paco and Sta. Ana districts— Construction and asphalt paving 35,000.00

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted, without Executive approval, June 18, 1961.
